:::{#thm-conditional-mutual-information-nonnegative}
#### Conditional mutual information is nonnegative

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$, $Y$ and $Z$
with finite [entropies](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy),

$$\cmutinfof{X}{Y}{Z} \ge 0.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

For each value $z$ with $\P(Z=z) > 0$,
let $\mutinfoatf{z}{X}{Y}$ be the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) of $X$ and $Y$
computed from their joint probabilities given $Z=z$,
so that $\mutinfoatf{z}{X}{Y} = \entropyf{Y \mid Z=z} - \entropyf{Y \mid X, Z=z}$.
Applying @def-conditional-entropy to $\entropyf{Y \mid Z}$ and to $\entropyf{Y \mid X, Z}$
expands each over the values $z$ of $Z$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\cmutinfof{X}{Y}{Z}
&= \entropyf{Y \mid Z} - \entropyf{Y \mid X, Z} \\
&= \sum_z \P(Z=z) \sb{\entropyf{Y \mid Z=z} - \entropyf{Y \mid X, Z=z}} \\
&= \sum_z \P(Z=z) \, \mutinfoatf{z}{X}{Y}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Each $\mutinfoatf{z}{X}{Y}$ is nonnegative by @thm-mutual-information-nonnegative.
Since $\P(Z=z) \ge 0$ as well,
every summand $\P(Z=z) \, \mutinfoatf{z}{X}{Y}$ is nonnegative,
so $\cmutinfof{X}{Y}{Z} \ge 0$.

:::
